Container.Name: maily
Container.Overview: Maily is the Universal Temporary Email Gateway & REST API Platform. Aggregates 8+ disposable email providers (Mail.tm, TempMail Plus, Temp-Mail.io, NoopMail, DispoEmail, and Gmail OAuth2) under a single high-performance REST API with 1-line automatic OTP verification code extraction and a sleek dark-mode web console.
Container.Description: Universal Temporary Email Gateway & REST API Platform

Config.Name: WebUI & API Port
Config.Description: HTTP Port for the Maily Dark Dashboard and REST API

Config.Name: Data Storage Path
Config.Description: Persistent directory for SQLite database (maily.db) and Fernet encryption key (maily.key)

Config.Name: Master API Key
Config.Description: Master Root API Key to secure dashboard and REST API. Must be non-empty when accessible across network.

Config.Name: Bind Host
Config.Description: Bind host inside container (0.0.0.0 for Docker networking)

Config.Name: Secret Key Path
Config.Description: Fernet encryption key path for credentials vault
